Vertical Ellipsis Symbol

There is no legacy Windows Alt code for Vertical Ellipsis because it is not in either the OEM code page 437 or Windows-1252 tables. The Unicode codepoint is U+22EE, which you can use as ⋮ in HTML, \22EE in CSS, or type with Alt+8942 on Windows (BMP only). If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly. Vertical Ellipsis is outside both legacy code pages, which is why U+22EE is the identifier that works across Word, HTML, CSS, Python and JavaScript. Vertical Ellipsis has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape ⋮ or the hex escape ⋮.

How to type vertical ellipsis on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 8 9 4 2 on the numeric keypad for the decimal codepoint 8942.
  4. Release Alt. The Vertical Ellipsis character (⋮) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type vertical ellipsis on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Vertical Ellipsis. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Vertical Ellipsis" and click the character to insert it.

How to use vertical ellipsis in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\22EE"; ()
  • Python: \u22EE or chr(0x22EE)
  • JavaScript: \u22EE or String.fromCodePoint(0x22EE)
  • JSON: "\u22EE"

Frequently asked questions

Is there an Alt code for ⋮?

No legacy Alt code exists for Vertical Ellipsis because it is not in code page 437 or Windows-1252. Use the Unicode codepoint U+22EE in HTML, CSS or the Character Viewer instead.

How do I type ⋮ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ⋮, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+8942 not work?

Alt+8942 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Vertical Ellipsis?

The Unicode codepoint for Vertical Ellipsis is U+22EE. You can use this value in HTML as ⋮, in CSS as \22EE, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ⋮ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+22EE, then click it.
